name: Soufflé Surprise
source: Starfinder Guilt of the Grave World
description: A misshapen blob of pastry and magic wobbles as it keeps rising beyond normal baked good dimensions.
disable: Cooking Lore|dc:18 (trained), DC 18 Survival (trained), or DC 18 Thievery (trained) to gently deflate the soufflé, or DC 23 Athletics to beat the soufflé into submission

offensiveAbilities.name: Sudden Rise
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger Zo!'s sabotage begins

Effect all creatures adjacent to a souffle take 2d6 Fire Damage damage with a Basic DC 23 Reflex Saving Throw save. On a critical failure, the creature is also Suppressed.

offensiveAbilities.name: Rise
offensiveAbilities.description: The souffle expands to fill a 10ft Type:burst centered on the cooking station. Each additional round, the souffle grows to fill all adjacent squares that are touching it. Creatures in these squares are affected by Sudden Rise.
